latin: Modus cognoscendi per ideas est ille cuius dixit Plato in Timeo paucos homines esse participes, sed bene deos omnes.
translation: Plato states in the Timaeus that only a few human beings share in this way of knowing through the ideas, though every god does fully; it is this mode of knowledge that is meant here.
